description: This source file implements parsing and validation functions for Certificate Transparency (CT) log responses, including JSON decoding of Signed Tree Heads and consistency proofs.

classes.name: JsonSignedTreeHead
classes.description: Structure for decoding Signed Tree Head JSON data, including fields for tree size, timestamp, root hash, and signature.

classes.name: JsonConsistencyProof
classes.description: Structure for decoding consistency proof JSON data, containing proof nodes.

methods.name: RegisterJSONConverter
methods.description: Registers JSON fields for JsonSignedTreeHead or JsonConsistencyProof for decoding.

methods.name: ConvertSHA256RootHash
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded SHA256 root hash and verifies its length.

methods.name: ConvertTreeHeadSignature
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded signature for the Signed Tree Head.

methods.name: IsJsonSTHStructurallyValid
methods.description: Validates the structure of a JsonSignedTreeHead object.

methods.name: FillSignedTreeHead
methods.description: Fills a SignedTreeHead object from JSON data, validating and decoding fields.

methods.name: FillConsistencyProof
methods.description: Fills a vector of strings with proof nodes from JSON data.
